name: Assistant for Home Assistant
tagline: A health check for your Home Assistant that speaks up only when a human must act
description: It watches a Home Assistant install for quiet failures: hardware gone unresponsive, cameras dark, updates that never landed, automations that quit firing. Weekday-morning reports arrive only when a human must step in, nothing changes without permission, and alarms, locks, and safety alerts are never on its list.
author: BowieHole
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
